description: Self-hosted Renovate, run weekly from bastion (scripts/renovate-run.sh, Cronicle-triggered). Opens tag-bump PRs for container images; merge = deploy via Argo CD.

packageRules.description: Group all patch/minor image bumps into one weekly PR; majors stay individual PRs read with coffee
Majors wait on the Dependency Dashboard until explicitly approved — a major upgrade is a decision, not a Sunday surprise (lesson of 2026-07-31)
Database majors never come from a bot: mongo upgrades are one-major-at-a-time maintenances with an FCV runbook (see history.md 2026-07-31)
